What claiming does

Four things happen when you claim

01

We verify it’s yours

A person on our team checks the claim against your company before anything changes. Your listing is never edited, moved, or handed over on the strength of a form alone.

02

Applications route to your email

Once verified, applicants for this opening come straight to the work email you claim with — not to a public link, and never through a staffing cut. We take no placement fee, ever.

03

Your guarantee clock starts

From the day your claim is verified, the 30-day guarantee runs: fewer than 3 qualified applicants in 30 days and your repost is free — a full 30 days, upgraded to Featured.

And you’ll see the numbers

Claimed listings get a day-7 and a day-30 performance report: views and applicants for your opening, true numbers only.

A qualified applicant is someone who applies through your post and matches the role’s trade, Michigan work area, and shift — the same definition published on our post-a-job page. If the guarantee triggers, claim the free repost by replying to any email from us. No forms, no argument.

Before you submit

Claims are reviewed before activation

There is no employer login on this board, and we don’t hand control of a company’s listing to whoever fills in a form. Every claim is reviewed by a human, and we may confirm it through your company’s published contact details before we activate it. Until a claim is verified, your listing stays exactly as it is today.

If you’re not the right person for your company’s hiring, send this page to whoever is — claiming takes about a minute.
